claims.text: The Caesar salad is not named after Julius Caesar; it is named after the restaurateur Caesar Cardini.
Caesar Cardini, an Italian-born restaurateur, is usually credited with creating the Caesar salad at his restaurant in Tijuana, Mexico, in the 1920s.
A classic Caesar salad is made with romaine lettuce and Parmesan cheese.
